title: Saturation and value as brand-personality controls
statement:
Saturation and value should be treated as separate brand-personality controls: higher saturation strengthened excitement, competence and ruggedness while lower saturation was associated with greater sincerity and sophistication, and lower value strengthened competence and ruggedness. (Scribd)

Options:
- Soft and light: low saturation (~42%) + high value (~100%) (fits: sincere, refined, approachable)
- Muted and deep: low saturation (~42%) + low value (~58%) (fits: competent, grounded, quiet)
- Bold and deep: high saturation (100%) + low value (~58%) (fits: energetic, rugged, strong)
- Bright and vivid: high saturation (100%) + high value (~100%) (fits: energetic, youthful, expressive)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general, fintech, health, luxury, b2b. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Exciting red and competent blue: the importance of color in marketing
source.authors: Lauren I. Labrecque; George R. Milne
source.venue: Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science
